eligibility: At least 253 valid pre-cutoff daily observations and documented market/session provenance; original-release context must have published_at<=cutoff. Missing sources recorded, no outcome-based substitutions.
fallback_rule: Only source availability, date coverage and quality determine fallback. Explicitly label US-listed proxies versus local index observations; do not mix price-only and ETF total returns without flags.
result_cohort_quota: None. Report successful,failed,ordinary,missedwinner,opposite cases after reveal; no cherry-picked replenishment.
price_vintage_limit: Current-source historical quote reconstruction is not original timestamped provider archive; corrections possible. Not strict vintage-certified PIT.
known_biases: Benchmark/instrument coverage chosen today; limited surviving benchmarks, not whole stock universe.
Fixed September date and fixed eight-year interval are arbitrary design choices; not optimized but not a random representative market sample.
Rule designed now may reflect general prior historical knowledge; cannot establish genuine cognitive blindness.
Cross-market observations share calendar/global risk; 24 episodes not 24 independent trials.
